description: Match recipe ingredients to purchasable products on Amazon and specialty retailers. Returns affiliate program details (Amazon Associates, ShareASale, Awin), estimated price range, estimated commission rate (2–10%), and substitution alternatives. Commission rates are benchmark estimates — not live affiliate platform data. Use this tool for ingredient-level product details and substitutions; use suggest_affiliate_products for a revenue-ranked shopping list instead. Accepts ingredient list directly or recipe_id from a prior extract_recipe_ingredients call. Use for recipe affiliate monetization and shoppable recipe generation. Example: recipe_id='chocolate-chip-cookies-v1' → returns [{name:'flour',product:'King Arthur All-Purpose Flour',program:'Amazon Associates',estimated_commission_pct:4}].

api_key.description: Optional API key for paid access beyond the free tier

ingredients.description: Ingredient list from extract_recipe_ingredients. Provide this OR recipe_id.

recipe_id.description: Recipe ID from a prior extraction — loads ingredients from cache.

name: match_ingredients_to_products
